title: Claude Code's API request records are reported as unrecognized
foundBy: session agent, while exporting a Claude Code 2.1.312 session that ran a workflow of 83 agents
details:
Claude Code 2.1.312 writes `api-request`, `api-request-blob` and `api-request-shape` records, and a `tools-used` record per turn. None carries a `uuid`, and the adapter classifies none of them. Each becomes a visible `meta` event and a `parse.warnings` entry (R38).

In the session that found it they were 1,148 of the 3,193 events across the 86 trajectories exported. Every lane carried an `unrecognized` badge, which hides a record type that is genuinely new. The records restate the requests the transcript already shows, so they belong in the ignore list (R37).
